title: 水産大手ウミオス、7月から缶詰値上げ　55品目で最大24％引き上げ「企業努力では困難」
extracted_text: 水産大手Umios（ウミオス、旧マルハニチロ）は1日、缶詰の「いわし蒲焼」や「国産いわしみそ煮」など家庭用加工食品55品目を7月1日納入分から値上げすると発表した。価格の引き上げ幅は約2～24％程度。原材料や包装材の費用が上昇しているため。 瓶詰やギフト商品も対象。ウミオスは「企業努力だけではコスト上昇分を吸収することが極めて困難な状況になった」とコメントした。
translated_text: Major seafood company Umios (formerly Maruhaniichiro) announced on the 1st that it will raise prices for 55 household processed food items including canned 'broiled sardines' and 'Japanese-style sardine miso stew' from July 1st delivery. The price increase ranges from about 2% to 24%. This is due to rising costs for raw materials and packaging materials. Bottled products and gift items are also included. Umios commented that 'it has become extremely difficult to absorb the cost increases through corporate efforts alone.'
title_en: Major Seafood Company Umios to Raise Canned Food Prices from July; Up to 24% Hike Across 55 Items 'Difficult Through Corporate Efforts Alone'
